evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context Layer 3 review; re-run at HEAD 14cbaffb08 (file sha256 e923e65315ec86ed, unchanged since commit): bun exit 0, 2 pass, 0 fail, 24 expect(). Both titles name owner ruling 1. No mocks: the committed live-check folder task-formats/blend/example-scenarios.spec through loadPlan (real Blend.load and TaskCommand.plan); facts folded through TaskEngineXState.apply; reads through TaskStatus.project, engine.view/ended and RunSupervisor.readyScenarios/supervised. Given every task trusted: plan pinned as tasks [T1, T1.1] and scenario S1 needs [T1.1]; after T1.1 is built, proved, verified and T1's review is trusted, the status file shows {T1 trusted, T1.1 trusted}; S1 is runnable (readyScenarios is exactly [S1], status pending); the run is still running and not ended. When rejected by its verifier: scenario.proved S1 passed puts S1 under supervision (supervised is exactly {S1: scenario}); scenario.verified with a rejected verdict gives S1 rejected with the verifier's reason; both tasks stay trusted. Then: engine.ended true; run state failed in the status projection and in view; tags [ended, stopped]. And: the reason is exactly ['acceptance not proved: S1 rejected']; the last log entry is the run moving to failed with that reason, right after S1's rejected entry. Control: the same run with S1 trusted ends done with no reason, so the rejection alone causes failed. No gap found.
